name: Forest fires in Mozambique
summary: Across the event of 2026-11-20: between 2026-10-28 and 2026-11-21, HH backscatter here changed by +0.8 dB and HV by +1.7 dB (mean within 500 m). Across the mapped area, 4% got at least 3 dB weaker and 0% at least 3 dB stronger.
method: NISAR L2 GCOV (terrain-corrected gamma-naught), frequency A, 2 passes on track 064-D-097-DHDH. Time series: mean linear power within 500 m of the point, in dB. Change map: HH after minus before, 5×5 mean filter against speckle, changes under 1.5 dB not drawn; 'after' is the first pass after the event of 2026-11-20, and 'before' the last pass before it.
